title.en: A POEM equipment checklist should be used before commencing the procedure to ensure the availability and proper functioning of all necessary materials.

statement.en: A POEM equipment checklist should be used before commencing the procedure to ensure the availability and proper functioning of all necessary materials.

commentary.en: The materials needed for POEM are summarized in [Fig. 1]. No studies to date have specifically assessed the impact of an equipment checklist on POEM outcomes. It is however important to consider that indirect evidence from various medical contexts suggests that the implementation of checklists can yield several benefits, including improved team communication, reduced medical errors, and a potential decrease in the incidence of AEs [7]. As a result, both the ESGE and the European Society of Gastroenterology and Endoscopy Nurses and Associates (ESGENA) recommend the incorporation of safety checklists into all endoscopic procedures. The verification of the availability and functionality of endoscopy equipment is an integral component of these checklists [7].
